summary: Iteration 4 verifies the bug fixes and new features shipped this turn: (1) EMPLOYEE DROPDOWN FALLBACK — GET /api/kiosk/config?event_id=default returns associates from the full staff_roster when the default event has empty associate_ids (verified backend + UI; 4 real roster members surface in the dropdown). (2) PRACTICE TYPE — POST /api/kiosk/leads accepts practice_type ('Employee'/'Private Practice'/'Group'), persists to lead.practice_type, is returned by GET /api/dashboard/leads/{id}, is exported in the CSV header ('Practice Type'), and renders on the kiosk step-2 UI as chips (data-testid kiosk-ptype-Employee etc.) and on LeadDetail as 'Practice type: Private Practice'. Kiosk response STILL returns only {id, spin_available} — no score/medicare leak. (3) SELECTED-EMPLOYEE ALWAYS-ALERT (KEY) — a GREY unmatched lead captured with associate_id=<Sam Thakkar's id> produces exactly one alert_log for that staffer with body containing 'Open: <APP_URL>/lead/{id}'. Dedup verified: capturing again for a tier-eligible on-duty associate still yields <=1 log per (lead, staff). (4) TWILIO STATUS WEBHOOK — verified end-to-end with REAL Twilio callback: our kiosk-driven capture produced a message with sid=SM1508fac0df… whose alert_log row transitioned from queued -> undelivered with error='Twilio error 30034' (real 10DLC registration failure). POST /api/twilio/status also accepts a manual form-post and updates the matching row. (5) REGRESSION — admin+staff login, one-spin-per-lead, kiosk 3-step flow, LeadDetail rendering, and CSV export all pass. Backend: 8/8 iter4 pytest cases pass in 12.96s; prior iter1/2/3 tests remain available.

issues: Same cosmetic dev-overlay hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' as iterations 1/2/3 — comes from Emergent's dev x-file-name overlay, not app source. No user-visible impact.

action_items: OBSERVATION (not blocking): The alert_log body's 'Open: <url>' link uses a DIFFERENT preview domain (947a83bf-cfd3-46a2-8eca-86106c3dcd44.preview.emergentagent.com) than the current REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL / APP_URL in .env (prize-wheel-hub-4.preview.emergentagent.com). The path /lead/{id} is correct and the URL is publicly reachable via ingress, so texts work, but the two hosts should be reconciled — either the backend/.env APP_URL was hot-swapped between deploys, or send_sms is reading a stale value. Verify APP_URL is the same env the frontend uses so texts don't confuse recipients or fail auth cookies on click-through.
OBSERVATION (carried from iter3): xlsx export currently buffers the workbook in-memory; consider streaming/write-only for very large lead tables.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_kiosk.kiosk_config correctly falls back to full staff_roster only when event.associate_ids is empty/missing — this is exactly the requested behavior and won't accidentally override an intentionally-empty ['associate_ids'] whitelist because the code path checks truthiness of the array (empty list falls through to fallback). Acceptable trade-off — an event with zero assigned associates gets the full roster, which is the whole point of the fix.

routes_kiosk._dispatch_alerts correctly deduplicates via `if existing: continue` on {lead_id, staff_id} and additionally uses `targets.setdefault` so a staffer who is BOTH tier-eligible and the selected associate gets exactly one entry. Verified in TestSelectedEmployeeAlert.test_dedup_single_alert_per_staff_per_lead.
routes_kiosk._dispatch_alerts falls back to ('340B', tier_340b, 'GREY') when no tier rule triggered — this preserves the color/shade in the SMS body even for GREY leads. Good.

server.twilio_status uses FastAPI Form(None) — correctly accepts application/x-www-form-urlencoded which is how Twilio posts. It updates by sid and no-ops silently if sid isn't found; consider logging a warning for unknown sids so future 30034/undelivered-from-outside-our-app debugging is easier.

deps._e164 correctly normalizes 10-digit US numbers to +1XXXXXXXXXX and preserves already-E164 inputs. Edge: numbers with non-US 11+ digits without + get a bare '+' prefix — could yield an invalid E164 for some international carriers, but not in scope for a US-only trade-show tool.
routes_kiosk.create_lead's kiosk response strictly returns {id, spin_available} — no score/tier/dollar/medicare leak. Verified.
routes_dashboard.EXPORT_COLUMNS includes ('practice_type', 'Practice Type'). Verified via CSV header parse.

rca of the issue: User's 'no employee dropdown' bug root-caused to: the default event 'Gujarat Physician' has associate_ids=[] so the kiosk_config route returned associates=[] and the UI conditionally hid the '<select data-testid=kiosk-associate>' (guarded by `config.associates?.length > 0`). Fix in routes_kiosk.kiosk_config lines 59-63 now returns the full staff_roster when event.associate_ids is empty. Verified: with 4 roster members and default event unchanged, the dropdown now renders and populates correctly.
